children: About $6.6 million worth of Ether moved from a wallet tied to Solana treasury firm Forward Industries to an exchange.
On Nov. 21, on-chain analyst ai_9684xtpa wrote on X, formerly known as Twitter, that 4,050 Ether linked to Forward Industries had been deposited to Binance.
If the Ether transferred this time is ultimately sold, it could result in a loss of about $8.27 million, he added. That would leave the asset's value down about 55.6% from the purchase price.

title: Solana Treasury Firm Forward Industries Deposits 4,050 Ether to Binance
